Command.Comment: Resume profiles with bounded container memlock; reuse latency

commands: docker run --rm --name zopro-phase-cpu-record-probe --network none --cpuset-cpus 0-95 --ulimit memlock=268435456:268435456 --cap-drop ALL --cap-add PERFMON --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --security-opt no-new-privileges --entrypoint /usr/lib/linux-tools/6.8.0-147-generic/perf 558215002830.dkr.ecr.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com/zolana-prover@sha256:bd04f1c9512b73de409578a9f42d0b2eb420f564e386ead60fee49984635e255 record --clockid mono -e cycles:u -m 512 -o /tmp/record-probe.data -- true > /var/tmp/zopro-phase-cpu-c7a/record-probe.log 2>&1

printf '%s\n' '{"reason":"First perf record failed before SDK execution: permission mapping pages","original_profile_sdk_requests":0,"latency_processes_reused":54,"change":"Container RLIMIT_MEMLOCK=268435456 bytes; same source,image,commands,clock and buffers. finish() { bench_rc=$?; trap - EXIT; docker inspect zopro-phase-cpu-c7a-resume --format '{{.State.ExitCode}} {{.State.OOMKilled}}' > /var/tmp/zopro-phase-cpu-c7a/resume-container-exit.txt || true; cat /proc/stat > /var/tmp/zopro-phase-cpu-c7a/host-stat-after-resume.txt; tail -n 20 /var/tmp/zopro-phase-cpu-c7a/bench-resume.log; exit "$bench_rc"; }

docker run --name zopro-phase-cpu-c7a-resume --network none --cpuset-cpus 0-95 --memory 30g --memory-swap 30g --pids-limit 1024 --ulimit memlock=268435456:268435456 --cap-drop ALL --cap-add PERFMON --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --security-opt no-new-privileges -v /var/tmp/zopro-phase-cpu-c7a/output:/output --entrypoint /bin/sh 558215002830.dkr.ecr.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com/zolana-prover@sha256:bd04f1c9512b73de409578a9f42d0b2eb420f564e386ead60fee49984635e255 -c 'set -eu
mkdir /output/hardware-resume
snapshot() { prefix=$1; for resource in cpu.stat cpu.max memory.events memory.max memory.swap.current; do if test -f /sys/fs/cgroup/$resource; then cat /sys/fs/cgroup/$resource > /output/hardware-resume/$prefix-$resource; fi; done; }
snapshot before
trap '\''snapshot after'\'' EXIT
/experiment/zopro-xtask perf /experiment/perf.json /output/perf --resume
/experiment/zopro-xtask workflow /experiment/comparison.json /output/comparison' > /var/tmp/zopro-phase-cpu-c7a/bench-resume.log 2>&1
